multiplicity: k = 3 is FIXED. No claim may be dropped on support after any outcome is seen; support is a validity diagnostic. If a claim's engine validity breaks in some phase world, the RUN holds — the claim does not disappear.

treated.definition: a registered phase-specific onset event for that claim
treated.direction: the frozen touched-line direction, evaluated at D-1

control.definition: same phase, same claim, onset == FALSE, grid observable on D and outcome-eligible
control.direction_rule: X-ONLY from D-1. A non-touch row has no contacted line, so the direction comes from the phase-specific lattice line NEAREST to Close[D-1], evaluated at D-1:
control.ASC: nearest ASC line at D-1 -> LONG if Close[D-1] > line, SHORT if below
control.DESC: nearest DESC line at D-1 -> same rule
control.CONFLUENCE: nearest ASC and nearest DESC at D-1; same sign -> valid consensus; opposite -> INVALID_CONFLICT; exact equality -> INVALID_EQUALITY
control.forbidden: D's own OHLC may not be used to assign control direction

directional_population: rows with direction in {LONG, SHORT}; for CONFLUENCE that additionally means consensus

inference_blocks.anchors: liquidity and volatility are taken at D-1
inference_blocks.why_direction_is_a_block: LONG market drift must not be compared with SHORT rows; putting direction in the block makes the comparison within-side by construction

statistic.form: blockwise Mann-Whitney/AUC with analytic tie-corrected null SE
statistic.weights: w_b = n_t,b / sum over ELIGIBLE blocks
statistic.Z: R / sqrt(sum w_b^2 Var0(U_b)),  R = sum w_b (U_b - 0.5)
statistic.eligibility: a block contributes only with >=1 treated AND >=1 control and N_b >= 2; degenerate blocks enter neither the numerator nor the weight normaliser
statistic.degenerate: a claim whose every block is degenerate yields Z = nan and is REPORTED, never silently zeroed
statistic.binding: the code digest above is the definition; prose parity with another family is not sufficient, because every phase world recomputes memberships
